cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: You Handle the Evidence
cards.instruction: Make someone else take responsibility for the evidence, loose end, or difficult follow-up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Will you explain my missing magician's receipt to the treasurer? You booked him.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You paid him. I only found his number.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then ring him for a replacement. You've got the number.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He won't send a duplicate unless the treasurer emails him directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then draft her email and get her to send it. Copy yourself in so you can chase him.

mechanism: A corrects the type of receipt and supervises the intermediary chain to shift the missing-document follow-up to B.
confusable: Mere delegation would tell B to call; S03 distinguishes duplicate evidence from a second payment and insists on actual completion.
comparison: Missing financial paperwork and remote follow-up differ from direct cashbox custody.
seedUse: Use the magician receipt, contact number and treasurer-only email condition as concrete correction opportunities.
